notes: SNES PLAYER_NAME commands are represented explicitly as Android-style %S(index,0) placeholders for comparison only.
Android anchor intervals include following English-empty localization slots.
Very-high-confidence SNES-to-Android-English identity is not rejected merely because French wording is freely adapted.
When French or Android segmentation crosses individual anchors, preserve and review the complete local sequence block rather than forcing a per-ID translation.

scenes.label: Jema - Pure Land directions after the Fortress revival

units.source_display:
JEMA:%S(0,0)! You okay?
 We barely got away!
units.android_english_display: Jema: %S(0,0)! You okay? We barely got away!
units.french_display: Gemma : %S(0,0) ! Tout va bien ? Nous avons réussi à nous échapper.
units.note: Speaker prefix + PLAYER_NAME + continuation match one Android anchor.

units.source_display:
We've failed to stop the
 Fortress's revival.
units.android_english_display: We've failed to stop the Fortress's revival.
units.french_display: Mais nous n'avons pas pu les empêcher de restaurer la Forteresse. Et l'Épée n'est pas prête...
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
The Mana Beast will appear
 and crash against the
 Fortress any minute!
units.android_english_display: The Mana Beast will appear and crash against the Fortress any minute!
units.french_display: Le bénévodon va certainement apparaître. S'il affronte la Forteresse, le monde en sera détruit !
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
It'll cause the destruction of this world. But we
 mustn't give up yet.
units.android_english_display: It'll cause the destruction of this world. But we mustn't give up yet.
units.french_display: Mais nous ne devons pas abandonner. Le sage Jach m'a jadis parlé d'un endroit perdu...
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
Sage Joch has spoken of the Mana Tree and Pure Land
 at the world's end.
units.android_english_display: Sage Joch has spoken of the Mana Tree and Pure Land at the world's end.
units.french_display: Un paradis terrestre appelé Terre pure de Mana, isolé sur une île aux confins du monde.
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
Usually it's hidden under
 a dense cloud barrier.
units.android_english_display: Usually it's hidden under a dense cloud barrier.
units.french_display: Elle est normalement protégée par d'épais nuages qui empêchent de l'atteindre.
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
But the Fortress is
 consuming the last of the
 World's Mana...
units.android_english_display: But the Fortress is consuming the last of the World's Mana--
units.french_display: Mais l'énergie de Mana faiblit, spoliée par la Forteresse.
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
and the barrier has surely
 weakened. You just might be able to land there...
units.android_english_display: --and the barrier has surely weakened. You just might be able to land there.
units.french_display: La barrière de nuages doit être moins dense. Vous devriez pouvoir la traverser.
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
The seeds that have powered up your sword are a small
 part of the Mana Tree...
units.android_english_display: The Seeds that have powered up your sword are a small part of the Mana Tree...
units.french_display: Les Graines de Mana sont issues de l'Arbre, et elles ont rendu à ton épée une grande partie de son énergie.
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
Find the Tree itself, and
 you could instantly revive
 the Mana Sword!
units.android_english_display: Find the tree itself, and you could instantly revive the Mana Sword!
units.french_display: L'Arbre devrait te permettre d'achever de restaurer l'Épée !
units.note: Unique exact English match in a long ordered run.

units.source_display:
%S(0,0):We have no choice, we
 must find that place...
units.android_english_display: %S(0,0): We have no choice. We must find that place...
units.french_display: %S(0,0) : Alors il y a encore de l'espoir ? Nous devons aller à la Terre pure !
units.note: PLAYER_NAME + source text match the final Android anchor of the run.

units.source_display: %S(0,0):And you are..?!
units.android_english_display: %S(0,0): And you are...!?
units.french_display: %S(0,0) : Mais vous êtes...
units.note: PLAYER_NAME + source text; Android 1852 is an empty localization slot.

units.source_display:
RUDOLPH:Master!
 Santa Claus!
 Are you all right?
units.android_english_display: Rudolph: Master! Santa Claus! Are you all right?
units.french_display: Renne : Maître Noël ! Vous êtes sain et sauf ?
units.note: SNES splits Rudolph's line around an event action; Android keeps one speech string.

units.source_display:
SANTA:Oh!..Rudolph!
 Sorry to have worried you!
 I'm fine, now!
units.android_english_display: Santa: Oh! Rudolph! Sorry to have worried you! I'm fine, now!
units.french_display: Noël : Oh ! C'est toi, Rodolphe ! Je suis désolé de t'avoir inquiété... Tout va bien, maintenant.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
I turned into Frost Gigas
 because kids just no longer believed in me.
units.android_english_display: I turned into a Frost Gigas because kids just no longer believed in me.
units.french_display: Je m'étais transformé en Gigas de glace car les enfants ne croient plus en moi, de nos jours.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
When Mana fades, kids lose
 their hopes and dreams.
units.android_english_display: When Mana fades, kids lose their hopes and dreams.
units.french_display: Lorsque la force de Mana faiblit, même les enfants perdent leurs rêves et leurs espoirs.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
I wanted so badly to bring
 back all of their dreams...
units.android_english_display: I wanted so badly to bring back all of their dreams...
units.french_display: Je voulais leur rendre leurs rêves... c'en était devenu une obsession.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
Then I heard that Mana
 Trees grow instantly, and
 become huge!
units.android_english_display: Then I heard that Mana Trees grow instantly, and become huge!
units.french_display: J'avais entendu dire que l'Arbre de Mana grandit très rapidement.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
I set off to find a Mana
 Seed, thinking I could grow a huge Christmas tree!
units.android_english_display: I set off to find a Mana Seed, thinking I could grow a huge Christmas tree!
units.french_display: Alors j'ai voulu m'emparer d'une Graine de Mana, pour faire pousser un immense arbre de Noël.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
But it was the SEED that
 changed my body, and turned me into that monster!
units.android_english_display:
But it was the SEED that changed my
body, and turned me into that monster!
units.french_display: Mais l'énergie de Mana m'a changé en cet horrible monstre.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
If the power of Mana is
 abused, it can be VERY
 dangerous!
units.android_english_display: If the power of Mana is abused, it can be VERY dangerous!
units.french_display: J'ai retenu la leçon : si le pouvoir de Mana est utilisé à mauvais escient, cela peut devenir très dangereux !
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display:
Here, take the Fire Seed.
 You need it, right?
units.android_english_display: Here, take the Fire Seed. You need it, right?
units.french_display: Je suis vraiment confus de ce qui s'est passé. Tenez, voici la Graine.
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

units.source_display: Got the Fire Seed!
units.android_english_display: Got the Fire Seed!
units.french_display: Vous récupérez la Graine du Feu !
units.note: Unique exact English match in ordered local run.

scenes.label: Resistance meeting before the Emperor truce

units.source_display: KRISSIE:What's wrong?
units.android_english_display: Krissie: What's wrong?
units.french_display: Chris : Qu'y a-t-il ?
units.note: Unique exact English match at start of ordered scene run.

units.source_display: ...I see...Dyluck is...
units.android_english_display: ...I see... Dyluck is...
units.french_display: Je vois... Alors, Durac est...
units.note: Unique exact English match.

units.source_display: Well, don't give up yet!
units.android_english_display: Well, don't give up yet!
units.french_display: Ne perds pas espoir !
units.note: Unique exact English match.

units.source_display:
We know Thanatos is up to
 something... But now the
 Emperor wants a truce!
units.android_english_display: We know Thanatos is up to something... But now the emperor wants a truce!
units.french_display: Nous avons appris que Thanatos était mêlé à tout ça, mais vous nous avez devancés.
units.note: Unique exact English match.

units.source_display: He's saying he wants peace!
units.android_english_display: He's saying he wants peace!
units.french_display: Mais l'Empereur a subitement demandé des pourparlers !
units.note: Unique exact English match; Android 1988 adds dialogue absent from the SNES source before the next anchor.

units.source_display:
GIRL:Maybe we should give
 the Emperor a chance.
units.android_english_display: Girl: Maybe we should give the emperor a chance.
units.french_display: Femme : Je comprends que tu aies du mal à faire confiance à ceux qui ont tué ton père.
units.note: Exact English identity resumes after Android-only 1988 and empty 1989.

units.source_display:
We've made the Emperor
 change his mind!
units.android_english_display: We've made the emperor change his mind!
units.french_display: Peut-être que notre détermination a réussi à lui faire changer d'avis ?
units.note: Unique exact English match.

units.source_display:
MAN:This is what we've
 been waiting for!
units.android_english_display: Man: This is what we've been waiting for!
units.french_display: Homme : La paix, c'est tout ce que nous voulons, après tout... on peut essayer.
units.note: Unique exact English match.

units.source_display:
KRISSIE:Okay, we'll go.
 Come with us! After this meeting your
 journey will be over!
units.android_english_display: Krissie: Okay, we'll go._ Come with us!_ After this meeting, your journey will be over! Dyluck will be himself again and there'll be no need to worry about the Mana Fortress anymore!
units.french_display: Chris : ..._ D'accord. Allons-y.  Avec vous !  Si Durac rentre et que la Forteresse est arrêtée, votre périple prendra fin !
units.note: SNES has three spoken statements plus a newline token; Android has four anchors because 1996 adds a Dyluck sentence absent from SNES. French redistributes the same local conversation across 1993-1996.

units.source_display: MAN:We'll go on ahead!
units.android_english_display: Man: We'll go on ahead!
units.french_display: Homme : Rejoignez-nous là-bas.
units.note: Unique exact English match after the sequence block; 1999 is an empty localization slot.
